sw.L: Tena msilewe kwa divai, ambamo [kuna] maisha ya upotevu, bali mjazwe na Roho, \v 19 mkiambiana kwa zaburi na nyimbo za sifa na nyimbo za kiroho, mkiimba na kupiga muziki kwa moyo wenu kwa Bwana, \v 20 mkitoa shukrani daima kwa ajili ya mambo yote katika jina la Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa Mungu Baba, \v 21 mkinyenyekeana katika hofu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Msilewe kwa divai, kwa maana huo ni ufujaji wa maisha bila kujizuia. Badala yake, mwacheni Roho awajaze. \v 19 Ndipo mtazungumza ninyi kwa ninyi kwa zaburi, nyimbo za sifa na nyimbo zinazotolewa na Roho, na mtamwimbia Bwana na kumpigia muziki kwa mioyo yenu. \v 20 Mtamshukuru Mungu Baba nyakati zote na kwa kila jambo, katika jina la Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 21 Tena mtanyenyekeana kwa kumcha {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa heshima.
sw.R: Msilewe kwa divai. Ulevi huleta maisha ya fujo na yaliyopotea bure. Badala yake, mwacheni Roho wa Mungu awajaze. \v 19 Ndipo mtazungumza ninyi kwa ninyi kwa zaburi, nyimbo za sifa na nyimbo nyingine ambazo Roho huwapa. Mtamwimbia Bwana na kumpigia muziki kutoka mioyoni mwenu. \v 20 Mtamshukuru Mungu Baba kila wakati kwa kila kitu, kama watu walio wa Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 21 Tena mtanyenyekeana, kwa sababu mnamcha {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa heshima kuu.

fr.L: Et ne vous enivrez pas de vin, dans lequel il y a de la débauche, mais soyez remplis par l’Esprit, \v 19 vous parlant les uns aux autres par des psaumes, des hymnes et des chants spirituels, chantant et célébrant le Seigneur dans votre cœur, \v 20 rendant toujours grâce pour toutes choses au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} à Dieu le Père, \v 21 vous soumettant les uns aux autres dans la crainte du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.B: Ne vous enivrez pas de vin : c’est une vie de désordre et de gaspillage. Laissez plutôt l’Esprit vous remplir. \v 19 Alors vous vous parlerez les uns aux autres par des psaumes, des hymnes et des chants inspirés par l’Esprit, et vous chanterez et célébrerez le Seigneur de tout votre cœur. \v 20 Vous rendrez grâce à Dieu le Père en tout temps et pour toutes choses, au nom de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. \v 21 Et vous vous soumettrez les uns aux autres dans la crainte respectueuse du {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.
fr.R: Ne vous enivrez pas avec du vin. L’ivresse mène à une vie folle et gâchée. Laissez plutôt l’Esprit de Dieu vous remplir. \v 19 Alors vous vous parlerez les uns aux autres avec des psaumes, des hymnes et d’autres chants que donne l’Esprit. Vous chanterez et ferez de la musique pour le Seigneur de tout votre cœur. \v 20 Vous remercierez toujours Dieu le Père pour tout, comme des gens qui appartiennent à notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}. \v 21 Et vous vous soumettrez les uns aux autres, parce que vous respectez profondément le {{christos:Christ|Messie}}.

ko.L: 그리고 술에 취하지 마십시오. 거기에는 방탕이 있습니다. 오히려 성령으로 충만하게 되십시오. \v 19 시편과 찬송과 영적인 노래로 서로 말하고, 여러분의 마음으로 주님께 노래하며 찬양하고, \v 20 모든 일에 대하여 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로 언제나 하나님 아버지께 감사하며, \v 21 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 경외하는 가운데 서로 복종하십시오.
ko.B: 포도주에 취하지 마십시오. 그것은 무절제하고 낭비하는 삶입니다. 오히려 성령께서 여러분을 채우시게 하십시오. \v 19 그러면 여러분은 시편과 찬송과 성령께서 주시는 노래로 서로 이야기하고, 마음으로 주님께 노래하며 찬양할 것입니다. \v 20 또 언제나 모든 일에 대해 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로 하나님 아버지께 감사할 것입니다. \v 21 그리고 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 경외하는 마음으로 서로 복종할 것입니다.
ko.R: 포도주에 취하지 마십시오. 술에 취하면 거칠고 헛된 삶을 살게 됩니다. 그 대신 하나님의 성령께서 여러분을 가득 채우시게 하십시오. \v 19 그러면 여러분은 시편과 찬송과 성령께서 주시는 여러 노래로 서로 이야기할 것입니다. 여러분은 마음을 다해 주님께 노래하고 찬양할 것입니다. \v 20 여러분은 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께 속한 사람으로서, 언제나 모든 일에 대해 하나님 아버지께 감사할 것입니다. \v 21 그리고 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 두려운 마음으로 공경하기 때문에 서로 복종할 것입니다.

vi.L: Và đừng say rượu, là điều dẫn đến sự phóng túng, nhưng hãy được đầy dẫy bởi Thánh Linh, \v 19 nói với nhau bằng những thi thiên, thánh ca và những bài ca thuộc linh, ca hát và chơi nhạc trong lòng mình cho Chúa, \v 20 luôn luôn tạ ơn về mọi sự trong danh Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} lên Đức Chúa Trời là Cha, \v 21 thuận phục nhau trong sự kính sợ {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.B: Đừng say rượu, vì đó là lối sống phóng túng, phí hoài. Trái lại, hãy để Thánh Linh đầy dẫy anh chị em. \v 19 Khi đó anh chị em sẽ nói với nhau bằng những thi thiên, thánh ca và những bài ca do Thánh Linh ban cho, và ca hát, chơi nhạc cho Chúa từ tấm lòng mình. \v 20 Anh chị em sẽ luôn luôn tạ ơn Đức Chúa Trời là Cha về mọi sự, nhân danh Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 21 Và anh chị em sẽ thuận phục nhau trong sự kính sợ {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.
vi.R: Đừng say rượu. Say rượu dẫn đến một đời sống buông thả và phí hoài. Trái lại, hãy để Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời đầy dẫy anh chị em. \v 19 Khi đó anh chị em sẽ nói với nhau bằng những thi thiên, thánh ca và những bài ca khác mà Thánh Linh ban cho. Anh chị em sẽ ca hát và chơi nhạc cho Chúa từ tấm lòng mình. \v 20 Anh chị em sẽ luôn luôn cảm tạ Đức Chúa Trời là Cha về mọi điều, như những người thuộc về Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}. \v 21 Và anh chị em sẽ thuận phục nhau, vì anh chị em kính sợ {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}}.

pt.L: E não se embriaguem com vinho, no qual há devassidão, mas sejam cheios pelo Espírito, \v 19 falando entre vocês com salmos e hinos e cânticos espirituais, cantando e louvando com o coração de vocês ao Senhor, \v 20 dando graças sempre por todas as coisas em nome do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} a Deus, o Pai, \v 21 submetendo-se uns aos outros no temor {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.
pt.B: Não se embriaguem com vinho, pois isso é uma vida desregrada e desperdiçada. Em vez disso, deixem que o Espírito encha vocês. \v 19 Assim vocês falarão uns aos outros com salmos, hinos e cânticos dados pelo Espírito, e cantarão e louvarão ao Senhor de todo o coração. \v 20 Vocês darão graças a Deus, o Pai, em todo tempo e por tudo, em nome do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. \v 21 E vocês se submeterão uns aos outros no temor reverente {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}}.
pt.R: Não fiquem bêbados de vinho. A bebedeira leva a uma vida descontrolada e desperdiçada. Em vez disso, deixem que o Espírito de Deus encha vocês. \v 19 Então vocês vão falar uns com os outros com salmos, hinos e outros cânticos que o Espírito dá. Vocês vão cantar e louvar ao Senhor de todo o coração. \v 20 Vocês vão sempre agradecer a Deus, o Pai, por tudo, como pessoas que pertencem ao nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}. \v 21 E vocês vão se submeter uns aos outros por reverência {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}.

am.L: በወይን ጠጅም አትስከሩ፤ በእርሱ ብክነት አለና፤ ነገር ግን በመንፈስ ተሞሉ፤ \v 19 እርስ በርሳችሁ በመዝሙራትና በምስጋና መዝሙሮች በመንፈሳዊም ዜማዎች እየተነጋገራችሁ፣ ለጌታ በልባችሁ እየዘመራችሁና እያዜማችሁ፣ \v 20 ስለ ሁሉ ነገር ሁልጊዜ በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም እግዚአብሔር አብን እያመሰገናችሁ፣ \v 21 {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} በመፍራት እርስ በርሳችሁ እየተገዛችሁ።
am.B: በወይን ጠጅ አትስከሩ፤ ይህ ብኩን የሆነ ልቅ ኑሮ ነውና። ይልቁንም መንፈስ ይሙላችሁ። \v 19 ያን ጊዜ እርስ በርሳችሁ በመዝሙራት፣ በምስጋና መዝሙሮችና መንፈስ በሚሰጣቸው ዜማዎች ትነጋገራላችሁ፤ ለጌታም በልባችሁ ትዘምራላችሁ፤ ታዜማላችሁም። \v 20 በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም ሁልጊዜ ስለ ሁሉ ነገር እግዚአብሔር አብን ታመሰግናላችሁ። \v 21 {{christos:ክርስቶስንም|መሲሕንም}} በአክብሮት በመፍራት እርስ በርሳችሁ ትገዛላችሁ።
am.R: በወይን ጠጅ አትስከሩ። ስካር ወደ ልቅና ወደ ባከነ ሕይወት ይመራል። ይልቁንም የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ይሙላችሁ። \v 19 ያን ጊዜ እርስ በርሳችሁ በመዝሙራት፣ በምስጋና መዝሙሮችና መንፈስ በሚሰጣቸው ሌሎች ዜማዎች ትነጋገራላችሁ። ለጌታ ከልባችሁ ትዘምራላችሁ፤ ታዜማላችሁም። \v 20 የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} እንደ ሆኑ ሰዎች ሁልጊዜ ስለ ሁሉ ነገር እግዚአብሔር አብን ታመሰግናላችሁ። \v 21 {{christos:ክርስቶስንም|መሲሕንም}} ስለምትፈሩና ስለምታከብሩ እርስ በርሳችሁ ትገዛላችሁ።

decisions.choice: reckless living: a life thrown away
decisions.reason: ἀσωτία is wasteful, uncontrolled living; the related adverb describes how the younger son wasted his money in Luke 15:13. ἐν ᾧ points to getting drunk on wine: that is where such living lies (Proverbs 23:31-35).

decisions.choice: be filled by the Spirit: the Spirit is the one who fills; what fills them is left open
alternatives: filled with the Spirit (the Spirit is what fills them)
decisions.reason: ἐν πνεύματι could mean the means (filled by the Spirit) or the content (filled with the Spirit); it could even mean their own spirit. Elsewhere in Ephesians ἐν πνεύματι usually means "by the Spirit" (2:22, 3:5, 6:18), and the prayer of 3:19 is that they be filled "to all the fullness of God". The contrast with wine is that something other than drink should control them. The command is in the present tense: go on being filled.

decisions.choice: speaking, singing, making music, giving thanks, submitting: what being filled by the Spirit produces
alternatives: separate commands: speak, sing, give thanks, submit
decisions.reason: The five participles hang on "be filled" and describe what a Spirit-filled church looks like. The last of them, "submitting to one another", is also the verb that verse 22 borrows, so the instructions to the household (5:22-6:9) stand under this same command.

decisions.choice: psalms, hymns and spiritual songs, spoken to one another: every kind of song the church sings
decisions.reason: ἑαυτοῖς here means "to one another", as in Colossians 3:16. The three words overlap: psalms, hymns of praise and other songs, all given by the Spirit (πνευματικαῖς). Singing builds up the church as well as praising God.

decisions.choice: in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ: as his people, through him
decisions.reason: To do something in someone's name is to do it as one who belongs to them and stands under their authority (Colossians 3:17). Thanks reaches God the Father through Jesus.

decisions.choice: submitting to one another: every believer places themselves under others
alternatives: each to those placed over them, as 5:22-6:9 set out
decisions.reason: ὑποτασσόμενοι is middle, an act of one's own will, as in Colossians 3:18. ἀλλήλοις, "one another", is addressed to the whole church. Verses 5:22-6:9 then apply it within the household; how far it runs both ways between wives and husbands, children and parents, slaves and masters is read differently.

decisions.choice: the fear of Christ: reverent awe toward Christ as Lord
decisions.reason: φόβος is fear, here the awe owed to Christ, who is Lord and will judge (2 Corinthians 5:10-11). It is the reason for submitting to one another. The same word comes back for the wife in 5:33.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "in the fear of Christ"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "in the fear of God". The earliest have "Christ".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article where the Greek has it: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: let the Spirit fill you (B); let God's Spirit fill you (R)
decisions.reason: Naming the Spirit as the one who fills follows the meaning decision (m2) and keeps the content open.

decisions.choice: Then you will ... You will ... And you will
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the participles into sentences, and the words "then you will" keep them tied to "let the Spirit fill you" (m3) rather than making them new commands.

decisions.choice: God the Father
decisions.reason: One article covers "God and Father": one person, God who is the Father.

decisions.choice: as people who belong to our Lord Jesus Christ
alternatives: in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m5).

decisions.choice: in the reverent fear of (B); because you stand in awe of (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make clear the fear is reverence for Christ (m7), not terror.

decisions.choice: sean llenados por el Espíritu
decisions.reason: The meaning decision makes the Spirit the one who fills. "Llenados por" names the Spirit as the agent; the familiar "llenos del Espíritu" would make the Spirit what they are filled with.

decisions.choice: someterse
decisions.reason: "Someterse" (to place oneself under) is the reflexive the Greek middle asks for, and is used for the same verb in 5:21-24. "Sujetarse" is the traditional wording and is also possible.

decisions.choice: mjazwe na Roho
decisions.reason: With "na" the Spirit is the one who fills, as the meaning decision says; without it ("mjazwe Roho") the Spirit would be what fills them. Balanced and Readable say it actively: "mwacheni Roho awajaze" (let the Spirit fill you).

decisions.choice: kunyenyekeana; kunyenyekea
decisions.reason: "Kunyenyekeana" (to humble oneself to one another) carries the reciprocal "one another" in a single verb, and "kunyenyekea" is used for the same Greek verb in 5:22-24. "Kutii" means to obey and would say more than placing oneself under someone.

decisions.choice: des chants inspirés par l’Esprit (B); d’autres chants que donne l’Esprit (R)
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:16: "spirituels" in current French often means witty or merely religious; Balanced and Readable say that the songs are given by the Spirit. Literal keeps "spirituels".

decisions.choice: Literal turns the Greek participles of verses 19-21 into a run of Korean clauses ending in "서로 복종하십시오"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says speaking, singing, giving thanks and submitting are what being filled by the Spirit produces. Korean can chain them with "-고", "-며" and close with one command in verse 21, so the reader can see they belong together and that verse 21 leads into verse 22. Balanced and Readable say "then you will", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "복종하다" for submitting, here and in 5:22-24, and "순종하다" for obeying in 6:1 and 6:5
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:18-22: Korean keeps the two Greek verbs apart, "복종하다" (place oneself under) and "순종하다" (obey). Here the verb is asked of every believer toward the others, so it is a voluntary placing of oneself under others (the meaning decision). "복종" can sound harsher in current Korean than the Greek; a reviewer may prefer another verb.

decisions.choice: "thi thiên, thánh ca và những bài ca thuộc linh" (L); "do Thánh Linh ban cho" (B), "mà Thánh Linh ban cho" (R)
decisions.reason: The words of the Vietnamese Colossians (3:16) for the same list (m4), so the two letters read alike.

decisions.choice: "thuận phục nhau" (5:21), and "thuận phục" for the wives (5:22, 24)
decisions.reason: The wives' submission is the first case of the submission asked of all believers (m2 in 5:22), so Vietnamese uses one verb for both, "thuận phục", the word of the Vietnamese Colossians (3:18): to place oneself under another willingly. "Phục tùng" sounds like forced submission.

decisions.choice: submeter-se
decisions.reason: For the whole household passage (5:21-24): "submeter-se" is to place oneself under another by one's own choice (m6), and keeps one word for verse 21 and for the wives in verses 22-24, as the English keeps "submit". "Sujeitar-se" sounds forced, and "obedecer" is a different verb, kept for children and slaves (6:1, 6:5).

decisions.choice: ተገዙ (submit, place yourselves under), here and in 5:22-24
decisions.reason: Paul's word is placing oneself under another, asked here of every believer toward the others (meaning decision m6). "መገዛት" says that; "መታዘዝ" (obey) is kept for the different word Paul uses of children and slaves in 6:1 and 6:5.

decisions.choice: መዝሙራት, የምስጋና መዝሙሮች, ዜማዎች (psalms, hymns of praise, songs)
decisions.reason: Three kinds of song (meaning decision m4) are named with plain words; "ቅኔ" is a particular form of Ethiopian church poetry and would say too much.

source.text: Αἱ γυναῖκες τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ, ὅτι ἀνήρ ἐστιν κεφαλὴ τῆς γυναικὸς ὡς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς κεφαλὴ τῆς ἐκκλησίας, αὐτὸς σωτὴρ τοῦ σώματος.

records.literal_gloss: The wives to the own husbands as to the Lord, \v 23 because [a] husband is head of the wife as also the Christ [is] head of the church, he [is] savior of the body.

en.L: Wives, [submit] to your own husbands as to the Lord, \v 23 because [the] husband is head of the wife as the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} also [is] head of the church, [and] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is the] Savior of the body.
en.B: Wives should submit to their own husbands, as to the Lord. \v 23 For the husband is head of the wife, just as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} is head of the church; and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the Savior of that body.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: no verb of its own in verse 22
alternatives: "Wives, let them submit to their own husbands"
decisions.reason: In the SBLGNT, as in the earliest witnesses (an early papyrus and Codex Vaticanus), verse 22 has no verb and takes "submitting" from verse 21. Most other manuscripts add one, some "submit" (ὑποτάσσεσθε) and others "let them submit" (ὑποτασσέσθωσαν), not always in the same place. The meaning is the same; the shorter text binds the verse more closely to 5:21.

decisions.choice: the verb is "submitting" from 5:21: wives' submission is the first case of the submission asked of all believers
decisions.reason: Verse 22 needs the participle of verse 21 to make sense, so the two belong together: what verse 21 asks of everyone, verse 22 applies to wives toward their own husbands. ὑποτάσσω in the middle is to place oneself under another by one's own choice (Colossians 3:18). It is a different verb from "obey", which Paul uses for children and slaves (6:1, 6:5).

decisions.choice: the household rules: Paul speaks to each member of the household
decisions.reason: Writers of the time set out the duties of household members (Aristotle, Politics 1.3), usually addressed to the man at its head. Paul speaks directly to wives, children and slaves, and gives husbands, fathers and masters duties too (5:25, 6:4, 6:9). He gives husbands the longest section (5:25-33). Colossians 3:18-4:1 is the shorter parallel.

decisions.choice: as to the Lord: as part of their service to the Lord
alternatives: as if the husband were the Lord
decisions.reason: ὡς τῷ κυρίῳ says how wives are to submit: as something done for the Lord. Slaves are told the same in 6:7, "as to the Lord and not to people". It does not put the husband in the Lord's place.

decisions.choice: head: the one who leads, as Christ leads and gives himself for the church
decisions.reason: κεφαλή is the head of a body. In Ephesians Christ is head over all things for the church (1:22), and the body grows from him (4:15-16). Here headship is tied to submission (5:24), so it includes leading; and the comparison with Christ defines it as leadership that saves, loves and gives itself (5:23, 5:25). Some read κεφαλή here mainly as "source".

decisions.choice: he is the Savior of the body: said of Christ alone
alternatives: the husband too is his wife's protector
decisions.reason: αὐτὸς σωτὴρ is emphatic: Christ himself is the one who saved the church, his body. The comparison with the husband does not extend to this, and verse 24 begins with "but". Some read it as a picture of the husband as protector of his wife.

decisions.choice: [submit] (L); should submit (B); submit (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is understood from verse 21 (m1, m2). Readable keeps "submit" here, unlike "follow your husbands' lead" in Colossians 3:18, because the word is shared with verse 21.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article where the Greek has it: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: The church is his body, and he is the one who saves it
decisions.reason: Readable says what "the body" is (5:30; 1:23).

decisions.choice: esposas, esposos
decisions.reason: Greek γυνή and ἀνήρ mean both woman and wife, man and husband; here they are wives and husbands. Spanish "mujer" has the same double sense, so "esposa" and "esposo" are used throughout 5:22-33 to keep it plain.

decisions.choice: [soumettez-vous], se soumettent (reflexive) at every level; leur propre mari, votre mari (B, R), in the singular
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:18: the verb, carried over from verse 21, is middle, an act of the wife’s own will (m2), and the reflexive "se soumettre" says that; "soyez soumises" reads as a state imposed on her. French says "votre mari" in the singular for each wife’s own husband.

decisions.choice: each group addressed as "... 여러분" in the letter's 합쇼체: "아내 여러분", "남편 여러분", "자녀 여러분", "아버지 여러분", "노예 여러분", "주인 여러분" (5:22-6:9)
alternatives: 해라체 commands to children and slaves
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:18-4:1: the household rules speak to each member of the church directly (the meaning decision). Keeping one speech level and the same respectful address for every group lets the Korean show that; where the English Balanced says "wives should submit", Korean speaks to the wives directly, which says the same thing.

decisions.choice: "[복종하십시오]" (L)
alternatives: no verb, as in the Greek
decisions.reason: The verb comes from 5:21 (the meaning decision); Korean needs a verb at the end of the sentence, so Literal brackets it.

decisions.choice: "Những người làm vợ" (L), "Người làm vợ" (B, R), and the same for husbands, children, fathers, slaves and masters through 5:22-6:9
decisions.reason: As in the Vietnamese Colossians (3:18), Vietnamese names a group it addresses by its role ("người làm ..."), which is respectful without being archaic.

decisions.choice: "Cứu Chúa" (L, B); "Đấng cứu" (R)
decisions.reason: "Cứu Chúa" is the Protestant title for the Savior; Readable puts it as a verb, as the English Readable does. The title is said of Christ alone (m6).

decisions.choice: mulheres; maridos
decisions.reason: Greek has one word for "woman" and "wife", and one for "man" and "husband". Portuguese "a mulher" beside "o marido" is the everyday way to say "wife", so the pair is kept through 5:22-33; "esposa" is more formal and "esposo" rare in Brazil.

pt.L: Mas, como a Igreja se submete ao {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, assim também as mulheres [devem se submeter] aos [seus] maridos em tudo.
pt.B: Mas, do mesmo modo que a Igreja se submete {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}, as mulheres também devem se submeter aos maridos em tudo.
pt.R: Mas a Igreja se submete {{christos:a Cristo|ao Messias}}. Do mesmo modo, as mulheres devem se submeter aos maridos em tudo.

am.L: ነገር ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያን {{christos:ለክርስቶስ|ለመሲሑ}} እንደምትገዛ፣ እንዲሁ ሚስቶች ደግሞ በሁሉ ነገር ለባሎቻቸው [ይገዙ]።
am.B: ነገር ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያን {{christos:ለክርስቶስ|ለመሲሑ}} እንደምትገዛ ሁሉ ሚስቶችም በሁሉ ነገር ለባሎቻቸው ሊገዙ ይገባል።
am.R: ነገር ግን ቤተ ክርስቲያን {{christos:ለክርስቶስ|ለመሲሑ}} ትገዛለች። እንደዚሁም ሚስቶች በሁሉ ነገር ለባሎቻቸው ሊገዙ ይገባል።

decisions.choice: but: Christ alone is Savior, yet the comparison holds for submission
decisions.reason: ἀλλὰ follows "he is the Savior of the body" (5:23). The husband is not his wife's savior, but the church's submission to Christ is still the pattern for the wife's submission to her husband.

decisions.choice: submits: the church places itself under Christ
decisions.reason: ὑποτάσσεται can be middle ("submits") or passive ("is subjected"). As in 5:21, the middle fits: the church gives itself to Christ's rule.

decisions.choice: wives to their husbands: the verb is understood again
decisions.reason: As in verse 22, the Greek leaves out the verb for wives; "submit" is carried over from the first half of the sentence.

decisions.choice: in everything: in every area of shared life
decisions.reason: ἐν παντί means in all things, not in some only. The frame Paul has set is "as to the Lord" (5:22) and "as the church to Christ".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article where the Greek has it: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: [should submit] (L); are to submit, should submit (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is understood (m3).

source.text: Οἱ ἄνδρες, ἀγαπᾶτε τὰς γυναῖκας, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς ἠγάπησεν τὴν ἐκκλησίαν καὶ ἑαυτὸν παρέδωκεν ὑπὲρ αὐτῆς, ἵνα αὐτὴν ἁγιάσῃ καθαρίσας τῷ λουτρῷ τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν ῥήματι, ἵνα παραστήσῃ αὐτὸς ἑαυτῷ ἔνδοξον τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, μὴ ἔχουσαν σπίλον ἢ ῥυτίδα ἤ τι τῶν τοιούτων, ἀλλ’ ἵνα ᾖ ἁγία καὶ ἄμωμος.

records.literal_gloss: The husbands, love the wives, just as also the Christ loved the church and himself gave up for her, \v 26 so that her he might make holy, cleansing [her] by the washing of the water in [the] word, \v 27 so that might present he to himself glorious the church, not having spot or wrinkle or any of the such things, but that she might be holy and blameless.

en.L: Husbands, love [your] wives, just as the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} also loved the church and gave {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} up for her, \v 26 so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might make her holy, cleansing [her] by the washing of the water with [the] word, \v 27 so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might present the church to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} glorious, not having spot or wrinkle or any such things, but that she might be holy and blameless.
en.B: Husbands, love your wives the way {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} loved the church and handed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} over for her. \v 26 He did this to make her holy, cleansing her by the washing of water with the word, \v 27 so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might bring the church to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} in glory, with no spot or wrinkle or any flaw like that, but holy and without blame.
en.R: Husbands, love your wives just as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} loved the church. He gave up {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} life for her \v 26 to make her holy. He made her clean by washing her with water and by God's word. \v 27 He did this so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} could bring the church to {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} glorious and beautiful, with no stain or wrinkle or any other flaw. He wanted her to be holy and without fault.

es.L: Esposos, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a [{{plural_you:sus|vuestras}}] esposas, así como también {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} amó a la iglesia y se entregó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} por ella, \v 26 para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} la santificara, limpiándola con el lavamiento del agua mediante [la] palabra, \v 27 para que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se presentara a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} la iglesia gloriosa, sin tener mancha ni arruga ni nada semejante, sino para que fuera santa e intachable.
es.B: Esposos, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} esposas como {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} amó a la iglesia y se entregó a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} por ella. \v 26 Lo hizo para santificarla, limpiándola con el lavado del agua por medio de la palabra, \v 27 a fin de presentarse la iglesia a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}} en gloria, sin mancha ni arruga ni ningún otro defecto, sino santa e irreprochable.
es.R: Esposos, {{plural_you:amen|amad}} a {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} esposas así como {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} amó a la iglesia. Dio {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} vida por ella \v 26 para hacerla santa. La limpió lavándola con agua y con la palabra de Dios. \v 27 Lo hizo para poder presentarse la iglesia a {{deity_pronoun:sí mismo|Sí mismo}}, gloriosa y hermosa, sin manchas ni arrugas ni ningún otro defecto. Quería que fuera santa y sin falta.

sw.L: Waume, wapendeni wake [zenu], sawasawa na jinsi {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} pia alivyolipenda kanisa na kujitoa kwa ajili yake, \v 26 ili alifanye takatifu, akilitakasa kwa josho la maji kwa neno, \v 27 ili {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwenyewe alisimamishe kanisa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} likiwa la utukufu, lisilo na doa wala kunyanzi wala chochote cha namna hiyo, bali liwe takatifu na lisilo na lawama.
sw.B: Waume, wapendeni wake zenu kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alivyolipenda kanisa, akajitoa kwa ajili yake. \v 26 Alifanya hivyo ili alitakase, akilisafisha kwa kuliosha kwa maji na kwa neno, \v 27 ili alilete kanisa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} likiwa na utukufu, bila doa wala kunyanzi wala kasoro yoyote ya namna hiyo, bali takatifu na lisilo na lawama.
sw.R: Waume, wapendeni wake zenu kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alivyolipenda kanisa. Alitoa maisha {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa ajili yake \v 26 ili alifanye takatifu. Alilisafisha kwa kuliosha kwa maji na kwa neno la Mungu. \v 27 Alifanya hivyo ili alilete kanisa {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} likiwa na utukufu na uzuri, bila doa wala kunyanzi wala kasoro nyingine yoyote. Alitaka liwe takatifu na lisilo na hatia.

fr.L: Maris, aimez [vos] femmes, comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} aussi a aimé l’Église et s’est livré {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour elle, \v 26 afin de la sanctifier, en [la] purifiant par le bain d’eau avec [la] parole, \v 27 afin de présenter à {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} l’Église glorieuse, sans tache ni ride ni rien de semblable, mais pour qu’elle soit sainte et sans défaut.
fr.B: Maris, aimez votre femme comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a aimé l’Église et s’est livré {{deity_pronoun:lui-même|Lui-même}} pour elle. \v 26 Il l’a fait pour la rendre sainte, en la purifiant par le bain d’eau accompagné de la parole, \v 27 afin de faire paraître l’Église devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans la gloire, sans tache, ni ride, ni aucun défaut de ce genre, mais sainte et sans défaut.
fr.R: Maris, aimez votre femme comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} a aimé l’Église. Il a donné {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} vie pour elle \v 26 afin de la rendre sainte. Il l’a rendue pure en la lavant avec de l’eau et par la parole de Dieu. \v 27 Il l’a fait pour pouvoir faire venir l’Église auprès de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, glorieuse et belle, sans tache, sans ride, sans aucun défaut. Il voulait qu’elle soit sainte et sans reproche.

ko.L: 남편 여러분, 아내를 사랑하십시오. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 교회를 사랑하셔서 교회를 위하여 자기 자신을 내주신 것과 같이 [하십시오]. \v 26 이는 말씀과 함께 물로 씻어 깨끗하게 하셔서 교회를 거룩하게 하시고, \v 27 티나 주름이나 그런 것들이 하나도 없이 거룩하고 흠 없는 영광스러운 교회를 자기 앞에 세우시려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 남편 여러분, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 교회를 사랑하셔서 교회를 위해 자신을 내주신 것처럼 아내를 사랑하십시오. \v 26 그분이 그렇게 하신 것은 말씀과 함께 물로 씻어서 교회를 깨끗하게 하시고 거룩하게 하시려는 것이었습니다. \v 27 그리하여 티나 주름이나 그와 같은 어떤 흠도 없이, 거룩하고 나무랄 데 없는 영광스러운 교회를 자기 앞에 맞아들이시려는 것이었습니다.
ko.R: 남편 여러분, {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 교회를 사랑하신 것처럼 아내를 사랑하십시오. 그분은 교회를 위해 자기 목숨을 내주셨습니다. \v 26 교회를 거룩하게 하시려는 것이었습니다. 그분은 물로 씻으시고 하나님의 말씀으로 교회를 깨끗하게 하셨습니다. \v 27 그분이 이렇게 하신 것은 교회를 영광스럽고 아름다운 신부로 자기 앞에 맞아들이시려는 것이었습니다. 얼룩도 주름도 어떤 흠도 없게 하시려는 것이었습니다. 그분은 교회가 거룩하고 흠이 없기를 원하셨습니다.

vi.L: Những người làm chồng, hãy yêu thương vợ [mình], như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng đã yêu thương Hội Thánh và phó chính mình vì Hội Thánh, \v 26 để làm cho Hội Thánh nên thánh, sau khi tẩy sạch [Hội Thánh] bằng sự rửa bằng nước với lời, \v 27 để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trình diện Hội Thánh cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cách vinh quang, không vết nhơ, không nếp nhăn hay bất cứ điều gì như thế, nhưng thánh khiết và không tì vết.
vi.B: Người làm chồng hãy yêu thương vợ mình như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã yêu thương Hội Thánh và phó chính mình vì Hội Thánh. \v 26 Ngài làm vậy để làm cho Hội Thánh nên thánh, tẩy sạch Hội Thánh bằng sự rửa bằng nước với lời, \v 27 để {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem Hội Thánh đến với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong vinh quang, không vết nhơ, không nếp nhăn, hay bất cứ khuyết điểm nào như thế, nhưng thánh khiết và không chỗ chê trách.
vi.R: Người làm chồng, hãy yêu thương vợ mình như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} đã yêu thương Hội Thánh. Ngài đã hy sinh mạng sống mình vì Hội Thánh \v 26 để làm cho Hội Thánh nên thánh. Ngài đã làm cho Hội Thánh được sạch bằng cách rửa bằng nước và bằng lời của Đức Chúa Trời. \v 27 Ngài làm vậy để có thể đem Hội Thánh đến với chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vinh quang và xinh đẹp, không có vết bẩn hay nếp nhăn hay bất cứ khuyết điểm nào khác. Ngài muốn Hội Thánh được thánh khiết và không có lỗi gì.

pt.L: Maridos, amem as [suas] mulheres, assim como também o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} amou a Igreja e entregou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} por ela, \v 26 para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} a santificasse, purificando-a pela lavagem da água com [a] palavra, \v 27 para que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} apresentasse a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} a Igreja gloriosa, sem mancha nem ruga nem coisa semelhante, mas para que ela fosse santa e irrepreensível.
pt.B: Maridos, amem as suas mulheres do modo como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} amou a Igreja e entregou a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} por ela. \v 26 Ele fez isso para torná-la santa, purificando-a pela lavagem da água com a palavra, \v 27 a fim de apresentar a Igreja a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} em glória, sem mancha, nem ruga, nem nenhum defeito desse tipo, mas santa e irrepreensível.
pt.R: Maridos, amem as suas mulheres, assim como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} amou a Igreja. Ele deu a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vida por ela \v 26 para torná-la santa. Ele a purificou, lavando-a com água e com a palavra de Deus. \v 27 Fez isso para poder apresentar a Igreja a {{deity_pronoun:si mesmo|Si mesmo}} gloriosa e bonita, sem mancha, sem ruga e sem nenhum outro defeito. Ele queria que ela fosse santa e sem culpa.

am.L: ባሎች ሆይ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ደግሞ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እንደ ወደደ ስለ እርሷም ራሱን አሳልፎ እንደ ሰጠ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ፤ \v 26 ይኸውም በቃል በውኃ መታጠብ አንጽቶ ይቀድሳት ዘንድ፣ \v 27 እርሱ ራሱ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እድፍ ወይም መጨማደድ ወይም እንደዚህ ያለ አንዳች ሳይኖርባት ክብርት አድርጎ ለራሱ ያቀርባት ዘንድ፣ ነገር ግን ቅድስትና ነውር የሌለባት ትሆን ዘንድ ነው።
am.B: ባሎች ሆይ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እንደ ወደደና ስለ እርሷ ራሱን አሳልፎ እንደ ሰጠ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ። \v 26 ይህን ያደረገው በቃሉ በውኃ መታጠብ አንጽቶ ቅድስት ሊያደርጋት ነው፤ \v 27 ይኸውም እድፍ ወይም መጨማደድ ወይም እንደዚህ ያለ ጉድለት ሳይኖርባት፣ ቅድስትና ነቀፋ የሌለባት ሆና፣ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን በክብር ለራሱ እንዲያቀርባት ነው።
am.R: ባሎች ሆይ፣ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ቤተ ክርስቲያንን እንደ ወደደ ሚስቶቻችሁን ውደዱ። ሕይወቱን ስለ እርሷ ሰጠ፤ \v 26 ይህም ቅድስት ሊያደርጋት ነው። በውኃ አጥቦና በእግዚአብሔር ቃል አነጻት። \v 27 ይህን ያደረገው ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ክብርትና ውብ አድርጎ ለራሱ ሊያቀርባት ነው፤ ምንም እድፍ ወይም መጨማደድ ወይም ሌላ ጉድለት አይኖርባትም። ቅድስትና ነቀፋ የሌለባት እንድትሆን ፈለገ።

decisions.choice: love: self-giving love, measured by Christ's
decisions.reason: ἀγαπάω is the love God shows and asks of his people. It is not a usual word in household rules of the time (Colossians 3:19). Here its measure is Christ, who gave himself up for the church (5:2).

decisions.choice: so that ... so that ... that: three purposes of Christ's self-giving
decisions.reason: Christ gave himself to make the church holy (26), to present her to himself in glory (27), and so that she would be holy and blameless (27). The last echoes 1:4, where God chose his people to be "holy and blameless".

decisions.choice: the washing of water: probably baptism, pictured as a bride's bath before the wedding
alternatives: spiritual cleansing only, with no reference to baptism
decisions.reason: λουτρῷ is a bath or washing. The cleansing that belongs to Christ's people is pictured in baptism (1 Corinthians 6:11; Titus 3:5). The picture of a bride washed for her husband recalls Ezekiel 16:8-14, where God washes Jerusalem with water and makes her beautiful. Some read it only as a picture of spiritual cleansing, without a reference to baptism.

decisions.choice: with the word: the spoken word of God, the gospel
decisions.reason: ῥῆμα is a spoken word. In 6:17 "the word of God" uses the same noun. The cleansing comes with the message of Christ believed and confessed (Romans 10:8-9). It could also be the words spoken at baptism.

decisions.choice: present the church to himself: like a bridegroom receiving his bride
decisions.reason: παραστήσῃ is the word Paul uses for presenting a bride (2 Corinthians 11:2). Here Christ himself prepares the bride and receives her. "Spot or wrinkle" describes the bride's flawless beauty; ἔνδοξον, glorious, says she shares his glory.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article where the Greek has it: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: gave up his life
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that giving himself up meant his death.

decisions.choice: by God's word
decisions.reason: Readable says whose word it is, following m4.

decisions.choice: in glory (B); glorious and beautiful (R)
decisions.reason: Readable adds "beautiful" to carry the bridal picture (m5).

decisions.choice: kanisa with class 5 agreement (li-)
alternatives: kanisa as "bibi arusi" with personal agreement
decisions.reason: Greek and Spanish refer to the church as "her", which carries the picture of a bride (meaning decision on 5:27). Swahili "kanisa" is a class 5 noun and takes li- agreement ("alilipenda", "alitakase", "liwe takatifu"); Swahili pronouns have no gender, so the bride picture rests on the words "josho" (bath) and "alilete kanisa kwake" rather than on the pronoun. A reviewer may prefer personal agreement here.

decisions.choice: la sanctifier (L); la rendre sainte (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Sanctifier" is the traditional word and Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable say "rendre sainte", which keeps the link with "sainte" at the end of verse 27.

decisions.choice: "교회" spoken of with "교회를", not "그녀"
decisions.reason: The Greek speaks of the church as "her", a bride (the meaning decision). Korean repeats "교회" where English says "her"; "그녀" is a written coinage that sounds out of place read aloud. Readable says "신부" (bride) once, so the picture of the wedding stays.

decisions.choice: "Hội Thánh" repeated where the Greek says "her"
decisions.reason: The church is pictured as a bride (m5). Vietnamese "nàng" would be poetic and "nó" would sound cold for the church, so the noun is repeated, which the Vietnamese ear accepts.

source.text: οὕτως ὀφείλουσιν καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες ἀγαπᾶν τὰς ἑαυτῶν γυναῖκας ὡς τὰ ἑαυτῶν σώματα· ὁ ἀγαπῶν τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα ἑαυτὸν ἀγαπᾷ, οὐδεὶς γάρ ποτε τὴν ἑαυτοῦ σάρκα ἐμίσησεν, ἀλλὰ ἐκτρέφει καὶ θάλπει αὐτήν, καθὼς καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν, ὅτι μέλη ἐσμὲν τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: So ought also the husbands to love the of themselves wives as the of themselves bodies. The [one] loving the of himself wife himself loves, \v 29 no one for ever the of himself flesh hated, but nourishes and cherishes it, just as also the Christ the church, \v 30 because members we are of the body of him.

en.L: In this way husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself, \v 29 for no one ever hated his own flesh, but [he] nourishes and cherishes it, just as the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} also [does] the church, \v 30 because we are members of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body.
en.B: So husbands are bound to love their wives as their own bodies. To love one's wife is to love oneself. \v 29 Nobody has ever hated his own flesh; instead, he feeds it and looks after it, as {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} does for the church, \v 30 because we are parts of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body.
en.R: In the same way, husbands should love their wives, because a wife is like her husband's own body. A man who loves his wife is loving himself. \v 29 No one hates his own body. People feed their bodies and take care of them. {{christos:Christ|The Messiah}} does the same for the church. \v 30 We are all parts of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} body.

es.L: Así también los esposos deben amar a sus propias esposas como a sus propios cuerpos. El que ama a su propia esposa se ama a sí mismo, \v 29 porque nadie jamás odió su propia carne, sino que la alimenta y la cuida con ternura, así como también {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} [hace con] la iglesia, \v 30 porque somos miembros de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo.
es.B: Así, los esposos tienen el deber de amar a sus esposas como a sus propios cuerpos. Amar a la propia esposa es amarse a uno mismo. \v 29 Nadie ha odiado nunca su propia carne; al contrario, la alimenta y la cuida, como {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} hace con la iglesia, \v 30 porque somos partes de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo.
es.R: De la misma manera, los esposos deben amar a sus esposas, porque una esposa es como el propio cuerpo de su esposo. El hombre que ama a su esposa se está amando a sí mismo. \v 29 Nadie odia su propio cuerpo. La gente alimenta su cuerpo y lo cuida. {{christos:Cristo|El Mesías}} hace lo mismo con la iglesia. \v 30 Todos nosotros somos partes de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} cuerpo.

sw.L: Kwa namna hii waume pia wanawajibika kuwapenda wake zao kama miili yao binafsi. Mtu anayempenda mke wake anajipenda mwenyewe, \v 29 kwa kuwa hakuna mtu yeyote aliyepata kuuchukia mwili wake, bali anaupa chakula na kuuhudumia kwa upole, kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} pia [anavyolifanyia] kanisa, \v 30 kwa sababu sisi ni viungo vya mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Basi waume wanawajibika kuwapenda wake zao kama miili yao binafsi. Mtu kumpenda mke wake ni kujipenda yeye mwenyewe. \v 29 Hakuna aliyewahi kuuchukia mwili wake; badala yake huupa chakula na kuuangalia vizuri, kama {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} anavyolifanyia kanisa, \v 30 kwa sababu sisi ni viungo vya mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Vilevile, waume wanapaswa kuwapenda wake zao, kwa sababu mke ni kama mwili wa mumewe mwenyewe. Mwanamume anayempenda mke wake anajipenda mwenyewe. \v 29 Hakuna mtu anayeuchukia mwili wake. Watu hulisha miili yao na kuitunza. {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} hufanya vivyo hivyo kwa kanisa. \v 30 Sisi sote ni viungo vya mwili {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

fr.L: Ainsi les maris aussi doivent aimer leurs femmes comme leurs propres corps. Celui qui aime sa femme s’aime lui-même, \v 29 car personne n’a jamais haï sa propre chair, mais il la nourrit et en prend soin, comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} aussi [le fait pour] l’Église, \v 30 parce que nous sommes membres de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps.
fr.B: C’est ainsi que les maris doivent aimer leur femme comme leur propre corps. Aimer sa femme, c’est s’aimer soi-même. \v 29 Personne n’a jamais haï sa propre chair ; au contraire, on la nourrit et on en prend soin, comme le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} le fait pour l’Église, \v 30 parce que nous sommes les membres de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps.
fr.R: De la même façon, les maris doivent aimer leur femme, parce qu’une femme est comme le propre corps de son mari. Celui qui aime sa femme s’aime lui-même. \v 29 Personne ne déteste son propre corps. On nourrit son corps et on en prend soin. Le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} fait la même chose pour l’Église. \v 30 Nous sommes tous des parties de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} corps.

ko.L: 이와 같이 남편들도 자기 아내를 자기 몸처럼 사랑해야 합니다. 자기 아내를 사랑하는 사람은 자기 자신을 사랑하는 것입니다. \v 29 아무도 자기 육신을 미워한 적이 없고, 오히려 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 교회에 하시듯이 그것을 기르고 돌보기 때문입니다. \v 30 우리는 그분의 몸의 지체들이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 남편들은 자기 아내를 자기 몸처럼 사랑해야 합니다. 아내를 사랑하는 것은 곧 자기 자신을 사랑하는 것입니다. \v 29 자기 몸을 미워한 사람은 아무도 없습니다. 오히려 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 교회에 하시는 것처럼, 자기 몸을 먹이고 돌봅니다. \v 30 우리는 그분의 몸의 지체입니다.
ko.R: 이와 마찬가지로 남편들은 아내를 사랑해야 합니다. 아내는 남편 자신의 몸과 같기 때문입니다. 아내를 사랑하는 남자는 자기 자신을 사랑하는 것입니다. \v 29 자기 몸을 미워하는 사람은 아무도 없습니다. 사람들은 자기 몸을 먹이고 돌봅니다. {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서도 교회에 그렇게 하십니다. \v 30 우리는 모두 그분의 몸의 지체입니다.

vi.L: Như vậy, những người làm chồng cũng phải yêu vợ mình như thân thể mình. Người yêu vợ mình là yêu chính mình, \v 29 vì chẳng ai ghét xác thịt mình bao giờ, nhưng nuôi dưỡng và chăm sóc nó, như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng [làm như vậy cho] Hội Thánh, \v 30 vì chúng ta là chi thể của thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vậy người làm chồng phải yêu vợ mình như yêu chính thân thể mình. Yêu vợ mình là yêu chính mình. \v 29 Không ai từng ghét thân xác mình; trái lại, người ta nuôi dưỡng và chăm sóc nó, như {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} làm cho Hội Thánh, \v 30 vì chúng ta là các bộ phận của thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Cũng vậy, người làm chồng nên yêu vợ mình, vì người vợ giống như chính thân thể của chồng. Người chồng yêu vợ mình là yêu chính mình. \v 29 Không ai ghét thân thể mình. Người ta cho thân thể mình ăn uống và chăm sóc nó. {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} cũng làm như vậy cho Hội Thánh. \v 30 Tất cả chúng ta đều là các bộ phận của thân thể {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: Assim também os maridos devem amar as suas próprias mulheres como os seus próprios corpos. Quem ama a sua própria mulher ama a si mesmo, \v 29 pois ninguém jamais odiou a própria carne, mas [a] alimenta e cuida dela com carinho, assim como também o {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} [faz com] a Igreja, \v 30 porque somos membros do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} corpo.
pt.B: Assim os maridos têm o dever de amar as suas mulheres como ao próprio corpo. Amar a própria mulher é amar a si mesmo. \v 29 Ninguém jamais odiou a própria carne; ao contrário, alimenta-a e cuida dela, como {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} faz com a Igreja, \v 30 porque somos partes do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} corpo.
pt.R: Do mesmo modo, os maridos devem amar as suas mulheres, porque a mulher é como o próprio corpo do marido. O homem que ama a sua mulher está amando a si mesmo. \v 29 Ninguém odeia o próprio corpo. As pessoas alimentam o seu corpo e cuidam dele. {{christos:Cristo|O Messias}} faz o mesmo pela Igreja. \v 30 Todos nós somos partes do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} corpo.

am.L: እንዲሁ ባሎች ደግሞ ሚስቶቻቸውን እንደ ገዛ አካሎቻቸው ሊወዱ ይገባቸዋል። ሚስቱን የሚወድ ራሱን ይወዳል፤ \v 29 ማንም ከቶ የገዛ ሥጋውን የጠላ የለምና፤ ነገር ግን ይመግበዋል፤ ይንከባከበዋልም፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ደግሞ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን [እንደሚያደርግ]፤ \v 30 የአካሉ ክፍሎች ነንና።
am.B: ስለዚህ ባሎች ሚስቶቻቸውን እንደ ገዛ አካላቸው ሊወዱ ይገባቸዋል። ሚስቱን መውደድ ራስን መውደድ ነው። \v 29 የገዛ ሥጋውን የጠላ ማንም የለም፤ ይልቁንም ይመግበዋል፤ ይንከባከበዋልም፤ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ለቤተ ክርስቲያን እንደሚያደርገው፤ \v 30 እኛ የአካሉ ክፍሎች ነንና።
am.R: እንደዚሁም ባሎች ሚስቶቻቸውን ሊወዱ ይገባል፤ ምክንያቱም ሚስት እንደ ባሏ የገዛ አካል ናት። ሚስቱን የሚወድ ሰው ራሱን ይወዳል። \v 29 የገዛ አካሉን የሚጠላ ማንም የለም። ሰዎች አካላቸውን ይመግባሉ፤ ይንከባከቡታልም። {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሑ}} ለቤተ ክርስቲያን የሚያደርገውም እንደዚሁ ነው። \v 30 ሁላችንም የአካሉ ክፍሎች ነን።

decisions.choice: in this way: as Christ loved the church (5:25-27), and as one's own body
alternatives: only forward: love them as their own bodies
decisions.reason: οὕτως looks back to Christ's love just described, and also forward to "as their own bodies". καὶ, "also", ties the husbands' love to Christ's.

decisions.choice: as their own bodies: because the wife is one body with her husband
alternatives: in the same way as they love their own bodies
decisions.reason: ὡς here means "as being" more than "in the same way as": the wife is, as it were, the husband's own body, as the church is Christ's body. The next clause ("loves himself") and the quotation of Genesis 2:24 ("one flesh", 5:31) point this way.

decisions.choice: flesh: one's own body
decisions.reason: σάρκα here is simply the body, with nothing of the sinful sense the word has elsewhere (2:3). The word prepares for "one flesh" in verse 31.

decisions.choice: nourishes and cherishes: feeds it and cares for it tenderly
decisions.reason: ἐκτρέφει is to feed and bring up (6:4 uses it of children); θάλπει is to keep warm, used of a nursing mother caring for her children (1 Thessalonians 2:7). Christ cares for the church in this way.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "because we are members of his body"
alternatives: "because we are members of his body, of his flesh and of his bones"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts add "of his flesh and of his bones", from Genesis 2:23. The earliest witnesses do not have the words.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article where the Greek has it: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: parts
decisions.reason: "Members" of a body now sounds like members of a club; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: body
decisions.reason: Readable says what "flesh" means here (m3). Literal and Balanced keep "flesh" for its link with verse 31.

decisions.choice: because a wife is like her husband's own body
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the meaning decision (m2).

decisions.choice: mwili for σάρκα
decisions.reason: Swahili uses "mwili" both for σῶμα (body) and for σάρξ (flesh). Here the meaning decision reads flesh as one's own body, so "mwili" is right at every level; "nyama" is meat. The same holds for "mwili mmoja" (one flesh) in 5:31. The Greek distinction between the two words is lost.

decisions.choice: les membres (L, B); des parties (R)
decisions.reason: English Balanced says "parts" because "members" suggests a club; French "les membres du corps" is the ordinary word for the limbs of a body, so Balanced keeps it. Readable says "parties".

decisions.choice: "자기 육신" (L); "자기 몸" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The flesh here is one's own body (the meaning decision), not human nature against God. Literal keeps the letter's word; Balanced and Readable say "몸", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "xác thịt" (L); "thân xác" (B); "thân thể" (R)
decisions.reason: Here flesh is one's own body (m3), with nothing of sin in it. Literal keeps "xác thịt", the word kept for sarx, as the context makes the sense plain; Balanced and Readable say "body".

decisions.choice: ሥጋ (flesh, L, B); አካል (body, R), in 5:29
alternatives: ኃጢአተኛ ተፈጥሮ (sinful nature) at Readable, as in 2:3
decisions.reason: Here flesh means one's own body (meaning decision m3), with nothing of the sinful nature; Readable therefore says "አካል", not the explanation used in 2:3. Literal and Balanced keep "ሥጋ", which also prepares for 'one flesh' in 5:31.

source.text: ἀντὶ τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὴν μητέρα καὶ προσκολληθήσεται τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν.

records.literal_gloss: Because of this will leave a man the father and the mother and will be joined to the wife of him, and will be the two into flesh one.

en.L: For this reason a man will leave [his] father and mother and will be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.
en.B: This is why a man will leave his father and mother and cling to his wife, and the two will be one flesh.
en.R: As the Scriptures say, "That is why a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife. And the two of them will become one, like one body."

es.L: A causa de esto, un hombre dejará a [su] padre y a [su] madre y quedará unido a su esposa, y los dos llegarán a ser una carne.
es.B: Por esta razón el hombre dejará a su padre y a su madre y se aferrará a su esposa, y los dos formarán una sola carne.
es.R: Como dicen las Escrituras: «Por eso el hombre dejará a su padre y a su madre y se unirá a su esposa. Y los dos llegarán a ser uno solo, como un solo cuerpo».

sw.L: Kwa ajili ya hili mwanamume atawaacha baba [yake] na mama [yake], naye ataungana na mke wake, na wale wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu mwanamume atawaacha baba yake na mama yake na kushikamana na mke wake, nao wawili watakuwa mwili mmoja.
sw.R: Kama Maandiko yanavyosema, "Ndiyo maana mwanamume atawaacha baba yake na mama yake, aungane na mke wake. Na hao wawili watakuwa kitu kimoja, kama mwili mmoja."

fr.L: C’est pourquoi l’homme quittera [son] père et [sa] mère et s’attachera à sa femme, et les deux deviendront une seule chair.
fr.B: C’est pour cela que l’homme quittera son père et sa mère et s’unira à sa femme, et les deux ne feront plus qu’une seule chair.
fr.R: Comme le disent les Écritures : « C’est pour cela que l’homme quittera son père et sa mère pour s’unir à sa femme. Et les deux deviendront un, comme un seul corps. »

ko.L: "이 때문에 남자가 [자기] 아버지와 어머니를 떠나 자기 아내와 결합하여, 그 둘이 한 육체가 될 것이다."
ko.B: "그러므로 남자는 자기 아버지와 어머니를 떠나 아내와 굳게 결합하고, 그 둘은 한 몸이 될 것이다."
ko.R: 성경은 이렇게 말합니다. "그러므로 남자는 자기 아버지와 어머니를 떠나 아내와 하나가 될 것이다. 그리고 그 둘은 한 몸처럼 하나가 될 것이다."

vi.L: Vì cớ đó, người nam sẽ lìa cha mẹ mà gắn bó với vợ mình, và hai người sẽ trở nên một thịt.
vi.B: Vì thế, người nam sẽ lìa cha mẹ mà gắn bó với vợ mình, và hai người sẽ trở nên một thịt.
vi.R: Như Kinh Thánh nói: "Vì thế, người đàn ông sẽ rời cha mẹ mình mà gắn bó với vợ mình. Và hai người sẽ trở nên một, như một thân thể."

pt.L: Por isso o homem deixará [seu] pai e mãe e se unirá à sua mulher, e os dois serão uma só carne.
pt.B: É por isso que o homem deixará o seu pai e a sua mãe e se apegará à sua mulher, e os dois serão uma só carne.
pt.R: Como dizem as Escrituras: "É por isso que o homem deixará o seu pai e a sua mãe e se unirá à sua mulher. E os dois vão se tornar um só, como um só corpo."

am.L: በዚህ ምክንያት ሰው አባቱንና እናቱን ይተዋል፤ ከሚስቱም ጋር ይጣመራል፤ ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።
am.B: ስለዚህ ወንድ አባቱንና እናቱን ትቶ ከሚስቱ ጋር ይጣበቃል፤ ሁለቱም አንድ ሥጋ ይሆናሉ።
am.R: መጽሐፍ እንደሚለው፦ «ስለዚህ ወንድ አባቱንና እናቱን ትቶ ከሚስቱ ጋር ይጣመራል። ሁለቱም እንደ አንድ አካል አንድ ይሆናሉ።»

decisions.choice: a quotation of Genesis 2:24
decisions.reason: Paul quotes Genesis 2:24 in the form of the Greek Old Testament, which has "the two" where the Hebrew has "they". He differs from it slightly: a different word for "for this reason", and "his" is not repeated with father and mother. Jesus quotes the same verse on marriage (Matthew 19:5; Mark 10:7-8), and Paul in 1 Corinthians 6:16.

decisions.choice: for this reason: in Genesis, because the woman was taken from the man; here, read alongside Christ and the church
decisions.reason: In Genesis the words follow the making of the woman from the man's body. Paul quotes them right after "we are members of his body" (5:30), and verse 32 says he is speaking of Christ and the church.

decisions.choice: become one flesh: one shared life, including the bodily union of marriage
decisions.reason: εἰς σάρκα μίαν follows a Hebrew way of saying "become". "Flesh" means a body, a person or a family: husband and wife become one new life, closer than their ties to their parents (as in Genesis 2:24).

decisions.choice: be joined: hold fast, in lasting loyalty
decisions.reason: προσκολληθήσεται is to be glued or bound fast to someone. The Hebrew verb in Genesis 2:24 is also used for Israel's loyalty to God (Deuteronomy 10:20).

decisions.choice: As the Scriptures say
decisions.reason: Readable marks the quotation (m1), which the Greek gives without an introduction.

decisions.choice: become one, like one body
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom (m3), as Genesis 2:24 does in this translation.

decisions.choice: cling to
decisions.reason: Says the strength of the verb (m4) in everyday words.

decisions.choice: the quotation of Genesis in the plain written style ("될 것이다")
decisions.reason: Scripture quoted in the letter keeps the plain written style, as at 4:8 and 5:14. Literal says "한 육체" for "one flesh", Balanced and Readable "한 몸", the ordinary Korean way of saying a married couple's shared life.

decisions.choice: "trở nên một thịt" (L, B)
decisions.reason: The quotation of Genesis 2:24 (m1) keeps the Hebrew "one flesh" as a short fixed phrase, "một thịt", as Vietnamese churches know it; "một xác thịt" would bring in the sense of sinful flesh. Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο μέγα ἐστίν, ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω εἰς Χριστὸν καὶ εἰς τὴν ἐκκλησίαν.

records.literal_gloss: The mystery this great is, I but speak with reference to Christ and to the church.

en.L: This mystery is great, but I am speaking with reference to {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} and to the church.
en.B: There is a great mystery here, but I am speaking about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and the church.
en.R: This is a great mystery, a truth once hidden that God has now made known. I am saying it is about {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} and the church.

es.L: Este misterio es grande, pero yo hablo con referencia {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} y a la iglesia.
es.B: Aquí hay un gran misterio, pero yo me refiero {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}} y a la iglesia.
es.R: Este es un gran misterio, una verdad que antes estaba escondida y que Dios ahora ha dado a conocer. Yo digo que se trata {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} y de la iglesia.

sw.L: Siri hii ni kuu, ila mimi ninasema juu ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} na juu ya kanisa.

fr.L: Ce mystère est grand, mais moi, je parle par rapport au {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et à l’Église.
fr.B: Il y a là un grand mystère, mais je parle du {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et de l’Église.
fr.R: C’est un grand mystère, une vérité autrefois cachée que Dieu a maintenant fait connaître. Je dis qu’il concerne le {{christos:Christ|Messie}} et l’Église.

ko.L: 이 비밀은 큽니다. 그러나 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 교회에 대하여 말하고 있습니다.
ko.B: 여기에는 큰 비밀이 있습니다. 그러나 나는 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 교회에 대해 말하고 있습니다.
ko.R: 이것은 큰 비밀, 곧 전에는 감추어져 있다가 하나님께서 이제 알려 주신 진리입니다. 나는 이것이 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}와 교회에 관한 것이라고 말하고 있습니다.

vi.B: Đây là một sự mầu nhiệm lớn, nhưng tôi đang nói về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} và Hội Thánh.
vi.R: Đây là một sự mầu nhiệm lớn, là một chân lý trước kia được giấu kín mà nay Đức Chúa Trời đã bày tỏ. Tôi nói rằng điều này là về {{christos:Đấng Christ|Đấng Mê-si-a}} và Hội Thánh.

pt.L: Este mistério é grande, mas eu falo a respeito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} e da Igreja.
pt.B: Há aqui um grande mistério, mas estou falando a respeito {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} e da Igreja.
pt.R: Este é um grande mistério, uma verdade antes escondida que Deus agora revelou. Estou dizendo que ele fala {{christos:de Cristo|do Messias}} e da Igreja.

am.L: ይህ ምሥጢር ታላቅ ነው፤ እኔ ግን {{christos:ክርስቶስን|መሲሕን}} በተመለከተና ቤተ ክርስቲያንን በተመለከተ እናገራለሁ።
am.B: በዚህ ውስጥ ታላቅ ምሥጢር አለ፤ እኔ ግን የምናገረው ስለ {{christos:ክርስቶስና|መሲሕና}} ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነው።
am.R: ይህ ታላቅ ምሥጢር ነው፤ ቀድሞ ተሰውሮ የነበረ፣ አሁን ግን እግዚአብሔር ያሳወቀው እውነት ነው። እኔ የምለው ስለ {{christos:ክርስቶስና|መሲሕና}} ስለ ቤተ ክርስቲያን ነው።

decisions.choice: mystery: a truth once hidden in God's purpose, now made known
decisions.reason: In Ephesians μυστήριον is God's plan, hidden before and now revealed (1:9, 3:3-6). Here it is the deeper meaning of Genesis 2:24: the union of husband and wife points to the union of Christ and the church. The Latin Vulgate translated the word sacramentum, but the Greek word does not name a rite.

decisions.choice: great: of great importance and depth
decisions.reason: μέγα says the mystery is weighty, not that it is very hard to understand.

decisions.choice: I am speaking with reference to Christ and the church: this is what the mystery chiefly concerns
decisions.reason: ἐγὼ δὲ λέγω εἰς sets Paul's own application beside the plain sense of Genesis 2:24. He does not deny that it speaks of marriage; verse 33 turns straight back to husbands and wives. But the great mystery is Christ and the church.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article where the Greek has it: "the [[CL]]".

decisions.choice: a truth once hidden that God has now made known
decisions.reason: The shared word list for Ephesians: Readable may explain "mystery" (m1).

decisions.choice: siri
decisions.reason: Swahili has one word, "siri", for both a secret and a mystery. Here it is a truth once hidden in God's purpose and now made known, not something still kept from people; Readable says so in the sentence, as the English does. "Fumbo" (riddle) would suggest something meant to puzzle.

source.text: πλὴν καὶ ὑμεῖς οἱ καθ’ ἕνα ἕκαστος τὴν ἑαυτοῦ γυναῖκα οὕτως ἀγαπάτω ὡς ἑαυτόν, ἡ δὲ γυνὴ ἵνα φοβῆται τὸν ἄνδρα.

records.literal_gloss: Nevertheless also you, the [ones] one by one, each the of himself wife so let him love as himself, the and wife that she respect the husband.

en.L: Nevertheless, you also, one by one, let each love his own wife as himself, and the wife [is to see] that she respects [her] husband.
en.B: But to return to you: each husband must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must see to it that she respects her husband.
en.R: But what I have said is for each one of you as well. Every husband must love his wife as he loves himself. And every wife must respect her husband.

es.L: Sin embargo, también {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, uno por uno, que cada uno ame así a su propia esposa como a sí mismo, y la esposa, que respete a [su] esposo.

es.R: Pero lo que he dicho también es para cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Todo esposo debe amar a su esposa como se ama a sí mismo. Y toda esposa debe respetar a su esposo.

fr.R: Mais ce que j’ai dit est aussi pour chacun de vous. Tout mari doit aimer sa femme comme il s’aime lui-même. Et toute femme doit respecter son mari.

ko.L: 그러나 여러분도 각각 자기 아내를 자기 자신처럼 사랑하고, 아내도 남편을 존경하도록 하십시오.
ko.B: 다시 여러분에게로 돌아가서 말합니다. 남편은 각자 자기 자신을 사랑하듯이 아내를 사랑하고, 아내는 남편을 존경하도록 하십시오.

vi.L: Dầu vậy, anh chị em cũng thế, mỗi người hãy yêu vợ mình như chính mình, còn vợ thì hãy kính trọng chồng.
vi.B: Nhưng trở lại với anh chị em: mỗi người làm chồng phải yêu vợ mình như yêu chính mình, và người làm vợ phải lo kính trọng chồng mình.
vi.R: Nhưng những gì tôi nói cũng là cho mỗi người trong anh chị em. Mỗi người chồng phải yêu vợ mình như yêu chính mình. Và mỗi người vợ phải kính trọng chồng mình.

pt.B: Mas, voltando a vocês: cada marido deve amar a sua mulher como ama a si mesmo, e a mulher deve cuidar de respeitar o marido.
pt.R: Mas o que eu disse vale também para cada um de vocês. Todo marido deve amar a sua mulher como ama a si mesmo. E toda mulher deve respeitar o marido.

am.L: ነገር ግን እናንተም ደግሞ እያንዳንዳችሁ በየግላችሁ ሚስቱን እንደ ራሱ እንዲሁ ይውደድ፤ ሚስቲቱም ባሏን እንድታከብር [ትጠንቀቅ]።
am.B: ለማንኛውም ወደ እናንተ ልመለስ፤ እያንዳንዱ ባል ሚስቱን እንደ ራሱ አድርጎ ይውደድ፤ ሚስትም ባሏን ለማክበር ትጠንቀቅ።
am.R: ነገር ግን የተናገርኩት ለእያንዳንዳችሁም ጭምር ነው። እያንዳንዱ ባል ራሱን እንደሚወድ ሚስቱን ይውደድ። እያንዳንዷም ሚስት ባሏን ታክብር።

decisions.choice: nevertheless: leaving the mystery, back to husbands and wives
decisions.reason: πλὴν turns from Christ and the church (5:32) to what it means for each married couple. However great the mystery, the duty is plain.

decisions.choice: that she respect: a command
decisions.reason: ἵνα with the verb here works as a command, as it sometimes does (compare 2 Corinthians 8:7). It matches "let him love" in the first half.

decisions.choice: respect: honor with reverence
decisions.reason: φοβῆται is the verb "to fear". Here it is not being afraid but the honor that belongs to the one she submits to, of the same family as "the fear of Christ" (5:21). Peter uses the same word in 1 Peter 3:2.

decisions.choice: love her as himself: an echo of Leviticus 19:18
decisions.reason: "Love your neighbor as yourself" (Leviticus 19:18) now applies to the nearest neighbor of all, who is one flesh with him (5:28-31).

decisions.choice: respect
decisions.reason: "Fear" would suggest being afraid (m3).

decisions.choice: each husband (B); Every husband (R)
decisions.reason: "Each" refers to the husbands just addressed.

decisions.choice: respecter (every level)
decisions.reason: As in English: the verb is "fear", but here it means to honor with reverence (m3); French "craindre" would say that she is afraid of him.

decisions.choice: ታክብር (respect, honour)
decisions.reason: The Greek verb is the verb of fear, used here for reverent respect (meaning decision m3). Amharic "መፍራት" toward a husband would be heard as being afraid of him; "ማክበር" gives the sense.
